name: Stack
description: A layout primitive: its children in a column or a row, with the gap from the space scale, alignment and optional wrapping. No Tailwind needed.

props.name: orientation
props.description: A column, or a row that runs in the text direction. Replaces the React and Vue direction prop (vocabulary: one prop for orientation). Emitted as data-orientation.

props.name: gap
props.description: The space between items, a step of the space scale (2 is --apui-space-2, 8px). Emitted as data-gap.

props.name: align
props.description: How items sit across the stack's axis (align-items). Emitted as data-align.

props.name: justify
props.description: How items and the free space share the stack's axis (justify-content); start and end follow the text direction. Emitted as data-justify.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Lets a row wrap onto more lines instead of overflowing. Emitted as data-wrap.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The stack; every child is an item.

requirements: Layout only: no role, and the reading order is the source order.
A row runs in the text direction, so it starts at the inline end in RTL.
A row that may not fit at 320px sets wrap (1.4.10).
